items.title: Jimmie "Kid" Clayton Interview
items.q: If people would hire me I'd just call up the Eureka or John Cashmere and I'd play with it.

ctx.x: Yeah. Did you ever have a brass band of your own, Jimmy?
No, I didn't have a brass band. If people would hire me I'd just call up the Eureka or John Cashmere and I'd play with it. That'd be my band right on.
